verdict.rationale: Pylon documents official mobile SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native, plus a JavaScript API for the chat widget. These SDKs only cover embedding and customizing the chat widget. For building against Pylon's platform data, the evidence shows only a raw REST API, webhooks and an MCP server, with no official client SDKs, and probes found no OpenAPI spec to generate one from. Missing for 10: official server-side/API client SDKs (e.g. TypeScript/Python) for issues, accounts and agents, a published OpenAPI spec, SDK reference docs, independent corroboration.
